analysis.title: More curve impulses (European Sunrise)
key_insights: Bond futures are supported on lower oil and negative Tech headlines. Yesterday's session was subdued with the US out on holiday.
Curve flattening extended, led by the front end. Schatz yields are back above 3.10% and the 2-10y IRS curve inverted. Bunds were rangebound outright and versus swaps.
EGB spreads did not benefit: 10y BTP-Bund hovers around 100bp and OATs continue to lag.

Fed speak is in focus after the latest US CPI print and rumours about Williams. Hammack, Daly and Williams speak this afternoon and evening. Further hawkish comments would raise the question of spillover into ECB expectations.
Central bank expectations have been the dominant driver of UST-Bund spreads since summer. Spreads widened after US CPI but remain below the early October highs.

Italy auctions 3y, 7y and a green ultra-long BTP today (expected €7.25bn). With maturities mostly in intermediate tenors, the report expects no lasting market effect. A new 30y UST ($25.0bn expected) is auctioned tonight.
German 2027 budget reconciliation session is today. More than 30 CDU/CSU MPs are pushing back against the SPD budget compromise.
Overnight: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to oust CEO Huang and the board may meet as soon as today. Nasdaq futures fell and Asian equities were weaker. EUR is below $1.11 and Brent below $92.
Tactical Bund futures positioning (RXZ6) is 'Sell into recoveries', with no target or stop given.

market_movers.rationale: Press reports (BBG/other sources) say Nvidia is preparing to oust CEO Huang over a relationship with an Nvidia executive. Nasdaq futures fell on the news.
